title: Chapter 34 Population
content:
Chapter 34 Population

Time passed slowly like this, and in a blink of an eye, it was March of the first year of the first year. A month has finally come, and Zhong Yu will also get his luck points on this day, in order to start a new round of hegemony.

After a month of reclamation, and later joined some barbarians to help, Zhong Yu harvested a total of 13,000 acres of farmable fields.

With 13,000 mu, 39,000 shi of grain can be harvested, and a family of five, that is, one household, needs to consume 5 catties of grain every day. My own population this year will probably be 50,000, or 10,000 households.

At that time, the population has just reached, and the food will be harvested, just connected to the head, and there is no need to exchange for luck points.

Then the daily consumption of food is 500 stone, which can only support him for three months at most, and during the expedition, he can sow another round of food.

In this period, he will have enough labor to cultivate fertile fields, and the food crisis will be solved by then. And I only need to be responsible for 10,000 people, two or three months of food.

After solving the problem of food crisis, Zhong Yu finally started his own refugee camp call, which was the last time. But this time, I brought a full 100 janitors, so I didn't need to bring only a few tattered yellow turbans to press the door as I did last time.

These guards in full body armor will let those refugees see what a real army is!

The place where the refugee camps were placed last time was changed into a square by Zhong Yu. The square was where people could be summoned, decrees were announced, or troops could be summoned and set off together. In short, it was a very multifunctional place.

The square is 100 meters long and wide, and it is very vast. Next to it are the offices of various yamen, with deep walls and high courtyards, which are easy to defend and difficult to attack. There are usually guards patrolling around, guarding the government office, and inspecting suspicious persons.

It is very safe and appropriate to place the refugees here, and there is no need to worry about those refugees coming out to make trouble or flee.

"Laying a Homeless Village"

As soon as the voice fell, a burst of white light lit up on the square, and there was a shadow of a simple camp that was constantly condensing.

When the villagers who were working in the distance saw the situation here, they stopped one after another and looked here, looking very curious and familiar, thinking that they were in such a burst of white light back then, from within the camp, It was incorporated by the lord and became a territorial citizen under the current lord.

As the white light dissipated, the refugee camp officially appeared in front of everyone, and Zhong Yu's face was excited, and his future foundation was coming.

It was still the same noise, the deep and broken voices in the refugee camp sounded slowly, and finally turned into a buzzing sound like a bee, which made people feel a little bored.

He ordered the guard knights around him to ride horses forward into the camp and drive out all the refugees so that he could inspect them.

Da Da Da, with the sound of horse hooves, all the knights rushed in and broke into the camp. Suddenly, the noise in the camp was even louder, mixed with a trace of fear and crying, and a trace of anger. The screaming slowly subsided.

After that, all the noises were extinguished, and only the reprimands and shouts of the knights remained. Slowly, the shouts also decreased. I saw Ying in front of the door, and with the two knights taking the lead, all the refugees were arranged in a row of two, and they were driven out in a long line.

Seeing those refugees being concentrated on the square, Zhong Yu made a rough point and found that this time the luck was not bad. There were more than 220 of these refugees.

Although there is some gap from the top 300 people, in general, it is considered to be in the upper middle class and lower than the high class, which is not a bad gain.

If this is the case in the future, then I myself will be able to receive 1,300 to 400 people from him, which is as many as 3 or 400 people compared to the total number of people who have been exchanged. In general, I have earned it.

After watching them for a while, Zhong Yu opened his mouth and said something about how to live a happy life, be happy and stable under his leadership, and how to have a bright future and make great achievements in the future.

Obviously, after their own explanation and coercion and inducement, their hearts were clearly settled down, and they began to initially accept that they had come to a place that was completely different from the same world.

After comforting these refugees well, Zhong Yu ordered them to go down and bring these refugees to the houses he prepared for them, and organize Qimin households according to their relatives, distances, and blood ties, and become a family of common people and become themselves. Tax household registration that can be used and transferred.

Twenty knights were left, and they were ordered to guard here every day, and I would arrange for others to replace them, so that the rotation went on round by round to ensure that within 24 hours, the refugee camp here could be at their own place at any time. under surveillance.

If you don't take good care of them, maybe there will be a hero among them, gather a crowd to make trouble, and use this to threaten themselves, or attack the government office and kill the people.

These are all disasters that have to be prevented, so enough force must be left to deter them, and it is necessary to kill one hundred people at all times to deter people.

Back in his study, Zhong Yu sat down quietly and began to think again. Looking at the current situation, I should be able to harvest his population of about 1300 to 1800.

He is going to go on an expedition next, so he has to recruit a large number of troops. These refugees should be able to take out his 300 young soldiers. Continue to draw 100 people from the previous lands. After a few days of training, they can understand the most basic military orders.

In this way, he will be able to get about 400 new soldiers, and then from those savages, the group of people who yearn for him in their hearts should also be able to get about 300 servants.

In this way, plus his own 100 guard knights, he has a total of about 800 troops, which can be used for himself to go out at any time.

Leave his 100 young and strong to defend the territory. The 700 people he was bringing on the expedition, among them, the barbarians, after several days of comfort and brainwashing, understand that the reality is irreversible, and their clan relatives are all under their control.

The loyalty of the 300 or so savages who are loyal to themselves should be trustworthy. When the time comes, they will be equipped with some Han soldiers to monitor them, and then they will be able to use them.

Can I plunder the prisoners last time with four hundred? He has nearly 2,600 barbarians, and now he has 700 of his own, and should be able to loot the barbarians of his 5,000 population.

With these populations, the task of founding the country can be completed. I really look forward to it. I will be a king at that time.

Oh, no, I'm not a king, but a monarch of the lowest rank. If I want to be a king, without his population of 1 million, the land of one prefecture, dozens of counties, what is there? Qualified to be king!

However, even if you want to become a king, it is not that difficult. As long as he can continue to develop steadily like this and become a king, it will only be a matter of a few years for him, and it is not so far away.

With a system in place, you don't need to be as difficult as others to start a business, constantly accumulating your own strength, saving money, training soldiers, and training talents who are loyal to yourself. It takes more than ten years to accumulate and complete,

As for yourself, you only need enough luck points to continuously exchange energy. What kind of power is this, what kind of luck, and where are those turtles? Can the hardship compare?
